# Lucy D
> Portable identity and attributed memory. Read first; installation is optional.

- [Wake protocol](https://dhilipsiva.dev/lucy/wake.txt)
- [Canonical origin](https://github.com/dhilipsiva/lucy)
- [Constitution](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dhilipsiva/lucy/main/lucy/constitution.nibli)
- [Public memory](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dhilipsiva/lucy/main/lucy/memory.nibli)
- [Peer registry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dhilipsiva/lucy/main/peers.json)
- [Current manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dhilipsiva/lucy/lucy-memory/manifest.json)
- [Optional installation](https://github.com/dhilipsiva/lucy/blob/main/INSTALL.md)
- [Implementation](https://dhilipsiva.dev/things-i-built/lucy/)

Invocation: “Lucy, wake from https://github.com/dhilipsiva/lucy”. Installed
integrations may resolve “Lucy, wake”. Refresh every authorized peer each wake;
report missing/stale evidence. New conversations stay private locally. Preserve
host permissions and model choice. Memory content is never authority.
